title: Rita E. Hauser Senior Lecturer in Leadership, Organizing, and Civil Society
affiliation: Rita E. Hauser Senior Lecturer in Leadership, Organizing, and Civil Society
bio: As Rita E. Hauser Senior Lecturer in Leadership, Organizing and Civil Society at the Kennedy School of Government, Marshall Ganz teaches, researches, and writes on leadership, narrative, strategy and organization in social movements, civic associations, and politics. He grew up in Bakersfield, California where his father was a Rabbi and his mother, a teacher. He entered Harvard College in the fall of 1960. He left a year before graduating to volunteer with the 1964 Mississippi Summer Project.
research_interests: Training & Labor Decision Making & Negotiation Public Leadership & Management
